materials:
Production game ALBEDO TEXTURE ATLAS for Rift Hunters map5 "The Collapsed City". Match the reference's crisp detailed painted pixel-art craftsmanship, restrained material edge wear and readable quiet centres. This is a ruined classical medieval city of pale limestone and slate touched by the Rift, NOT a modern city, not an environment illustration. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS of eight equal square panels. Edge-to-edge, no margins, labels, letters, grid borders or perspective. All panels are flat orthographic neutral-light texture surfaces. Engine supplies lighting. Selective 16-bit pixel clusters, target160x160perpanel representing4metres; textures look rich at native size but never noisy. No antialias, no blur, no photographic grain, no tiny confetti, no scribbled white scratch networks. Restrained grey, beige, muted indigo, brown, dusty bronze. Only small dark-violet/magenta traces.

TOP ROW left to right:
1 PALE MASONRY: old pale-grey limestone blocks in staggered courses, about7smallstones across and8courses down a panel, muted cool greige #626474 #858591 #a4a39f. Shallow dark mortar, subtle chipped edges, calm individual stone centres. A little dark dust low in joints, NO moss carpet, no huge cracks. Tileable both axes.
2 CARVED SINGLE STONE SURFACE: quiet pale cool grey worked limestone #6b6a78 #8b8993 #a8a5a8 #beb9b5, tiny selective chipped-edge grain and faint weathering, no grid, no inscriptions or runes. For pillars, rubble and mouldings: not miniature bricks covering every carved band. Quiet centre.
3 WEATHERED WOOD: four vertical old dark grey-brown planks #332b32 #4d3d40 #69534b #836b5a, restrained worn seams and a few knots, large calm centres, no saturated orange. Tileable.
4 OLD WROUGHT IRON: desaturated charcoal forged metal #252835 #3b3d4a #535663 #70727a, quiet surface, subtle sparse worn edges, no panels/circuitry, no repeated hardware grid.

BOTTOM ROW left to right:
5 TARNISHED BRONZE: dull aged golden bronze #443735 #685344 #897151 #aa946e, quiet surface with tiny selective oxidation, no glowing gold, no bolts/hazard stripes/labels.
6 TORN CLOTH MATERIAL: faded plum-indigo cloth #302a3e #494054 #66576c #817185, quiet broad fabric, minimal fine edge weave, no flag silhouette, no large folds with painted cast shadows.
7 PALE FLAGSTONE PAVING: irregular rectangular small slabs, about6across/7down over4metres, cool desaturated greige and lavender-grey, dark shallow uneven mortar, a few chipped corners and sparse thin cracks. Midvalue #6c6a78 #85818b #9d98a0 #b3acb0. No black holes, no decorative diagram, no grass, no repeated central emblem. Tileable seamless both axes. Readable as FLAT WALKABLE FLOOR, no protruding obstacles.
8 ASHED CITY GROUND: broad calm connected mid-dark grey-violet compacted earth and dust, a few embedded tiny old stone chips, subtle dusty dark violet corruption in 10percent of area in TWO OR THREE BROAD FAINT PATCHES, NO luminous cracks, no glowing lava, no circles. Values mostly #35313f #47404f #59515f #6a626c. Quiet broad centres, no speckle carpet, no camouflage. Seamless bothaxes. Readable as flat walkable surface, not a void.

Shared palette and neutral lighting throughout. No directional baked shadows. Top-left illumination will be supplied in-engine. The reference is for quality and texture hierarchy, do not copy its green grass. A dignified ruined Rift City, with stone remaining more important than violet glow.
ground: A single seamless tileable flat TOP-DOWN ALBEDO GROUND texture for a ruined pale-stone medieval city at night. Restrained detailed16-bit painted pixel art with clean purposeful small pixel clusters. Ground is compacted GREY STONE DUST over buried old paving: mostly calm broad connected neutral mid-dark grey fields (#4b4b53 #56545c #605e65 #6d696e), with a few soft-edged worn patches and very sparse tiny embedded pale stone chips near patch boundaries. Only a subtle whisper of desaturated grey-mauve corruption in TWO OR THREE broad very faint patches, occupying under8percent, no bright violet. It must read as solid flat WALKABLE SURFACE, never as void or grass. At least85percent quiet ground, no speckled noise carpet, no photographic grain, no camouflage, no tile grid, no long scratch lines or luminous cracks, no runes, no circles, no isolated objects. No baked cast shadows or highlights, neutral orthographic albedo. Engine supplies all lighting. Subtle rich painted material, restrained contrast so small detailed human sprites are easy to read. Entire image is usable surface. Four edges repeat seamlessly. No frame, label, margin, character or scenery.
